newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - AT&T response to BT/MCI merger.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - AT&T response to BT/MCI merger.

text.p: Below is the full text of the press release statement by AT&T Corp responding to the announcment of the merger between British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Communications Corp. -----------------------PRESS RELEASE--------------------------

NEW YORK, Nov. 3 /PRNewswire/ -- Following is the text of AT&T's (NYSE: T) statement responding to the announcement of a proposed definitive merger agreement between British Telecommunications plc (NYSE: BTY) and MCI (Nasdaq: MCIC) earlier today. The statement may be attributed to AT&T Chairman Robert E. Allen.
"AT&T is confident of our ability to provide the highest quality global services to customers and we welcome real competition in that arena.

"At the same time, we believe this proposed merger must get the scrutiny it deserves from the U.S. Department of Justice, the Federal Communications Commission and the appropriate regulatory authorities in the United Kingdom and Europe. We would expect that our government would condition any such approval on the complete and unqualified opening of the telecom market in the United Kingdom.
"In spite of the progress made to establish competition, the UK market is not fully open. New entrants and carriers who want to serve customers still face significant barriers.

"BT still controls more than 90 percent of all local telephone connections. And equal access to customers and telephone providers simply does not exist. For instance, competitors to BT need to have equal facilities opportunities into and out of the UK, as well as cost-based rates for handling international calling.

"The relative openness of telecom markets is not just a UK issue. The ability of a company with this kind of market power to negatively impact competition and reduce customer choice makes the evaluation of this proposed merger a global priority of the highest order."
